title: Owens summons lightning near the Camden Bridge

tellings.quote: Owens pointed his finger at the bridge and according to the affidavit, lightning struck within a few moments, not hitting the bridge, but in that general vicinity.

plain: In Philadelphia in the 1960s, a man named Ted Owens is said to have pointed his finger at the Camden Bridge, and within moments lightning struck nearby, not on the bridge but in that general area. The PhD Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels this from a sworn statement by a witness named Sydney Margolies, and he also names the books How to Contact Space People and The PK Man ("PK" stands for psychokinesis, moving things with the mind). If the statement is right, Owens could call up weather on command.
